steps.cap: Every stage so far makes chips. Before any of them can be sold, a machine tests each one, starting while the chips are still on the wafer.
A probe card lowers thousands of needles onto one chip. They press onto small metal pads on its surface.
Through the needles, the tester sends signals into the chip and reads what comes back. It checks every answer.
The tester steps from chip to chip across the wafer. It marks any chip that answers wrong, and that chip goes no further.
Only chips that pass go on to be packaged. A modern accelerator glues together a dozen expensive pieces, and one bad piece throws away all of them, so each piece is tested before it goes in.
